releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.31 — blocking is now a pause, not a delete. Blocking someone keeps their chat and your entire history exactly where it is (the chat stays in the list, their messages stay on screen), hides them from Friends/Find, and swaps the message box for an Unblock banner; incoming messages are held back until you unblock. Unblocking drops you back into the conversation at the exact message you left off — nothing is ever deleted, on either side. The block list lives on your phone, and Settings ▸ Blocked Users lets you undo it any time.
